target: Akita AI Data Center (BitGrid / S2 JV)
notes: Mubadala reported to be 'weighing' up to JPY1tn (~US$6.3-7B) for a proposed 500MW AI data center in Akita Prefecture, Japan, developed by US startup BitGrid with Japanese IT firm S2. No commitment, financing timetable, or ownership structure has been announced. Several outlets (incl. GlobalSWF) say the investment would route through MGX, Mubadala's dedicated AI vehicle, rather than Mubadala directly -- flagging allocator-attribution ambiguity between the two tracked entities. Bloomberg reports total project investment across all participants could reach JPY2tn.
